problems.title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
problems.notes: n and m = number of nodes in the two input lists; reuses existing nodes

problems.title: Search a 2D Matrix
problems.notes: m = number of rows; n = number of columns; binary search treats the nonempty sorted matrix as a flat sequence without copying it

problems.title: Linked List Cycle
problems.notes: n = number of distinct nodes reachable from head; uses Floyd's slow and fast pointers

problems.title: Reorder List
problems.notes: n = number of nodes in the linked list; splits the list, reverses the second half, and interleaves existing nodes

problems.title: LRU Cache
problems.time: Expected O(1) per get; expected amortized O(1) per put; O(1) initialization
problems.space: O(c) for the hash map and doubly linked list
problems.notes: c = cache capacity; at most c cached entries remain after each operation, plus two sentinel nodes. A new put can temporarily hold c + 1 entries before eviction; hash-map resizing is amortized

problems.title: Reverse Linked List
problems.notes: n = number of nodes in the linked list; reverses the list in place

problems.title: Binary Search
problems.notes: n = number of elements in the sorted input list

problems.title: Koko Eating Bananas
problems.time: O(n log M), or O(n) when M = 1
problems.notes: n = number of piles; M = largest pile size; each binary-search step sums required hours using a generator without storing per-pile results
